text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa……
Phew~~~…… …………

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm~…… Kraft, you good~?
Seems like you can't really focus today~……

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
You'll get hurt if you lose focus!
Maybe best to call it after 1 more lap!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry about that……!
I'll do just that!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Not good, head's not in it at all! The 『NHK Mile C』, huh……
but I've always dreamed of the 『Oaks』, skipping it feels so……)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Must I give up on Triple Tiara?
A matter of aptitude……sure, that might be true, but……)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Still, it's a race—you never know till you run, right?
Lacking aptitude doesn't mean……zero chance of victory……)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Nnnnnaaaaaa~~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Kraft-san……appears deeply troubled.

I have said all that needed saying. All that remains……
is awaiting the answer she reaches.

I have said all that needed saying. All that remains……
is awaiting the answer she reaches.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……Indeed. In the end, she alone must run that race.
And the only one who can decide her path――is herself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (Though……perhaps having a small word with her would not hurt――)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Ahhh……in the end,
training finished before I could figure things out……)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Only my training menu was lightened today.
Trainer-san arranged that, right? ……So I could sort my thoughts.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (My next race……my answer is――)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Kraft, a request.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Permission for night outing obtained.
――Run alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh……? S-sure, fine by me, but……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew~…… All set, Cesario!
How many meters we running?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ……Distance is your choice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, me? But Cesario, you're the one who――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……? Hmm……alright.
I'll pick. ……Then――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……――2400m, please.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Understood. ……Commencing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ready――Start!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(What Trainer-san said……about my aptitude. I know.
At this distance, I've never beaten Cesario once.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Even so――……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaa———!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaa, haaa, haa……!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ――My victory.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: One more time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's run……again!
Same distance! 2400m……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I know I probably won't win this time either――still!
No backing down now!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Triple Tiara stage!
My cherished dream……my aspiration……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Please, Cesario! One more time……!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Understood. 2400m.
……Forward, Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――Haaaaaaaa!

Afterward, Kraft repeatedly challenged
Cesario across the 『Oaks』 distance.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa-, Haa-……~~~ One more time!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fuu……as you wish.
……One warning, however.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
2400m――at 『Oaks』 distance, no concessions.
I will never let you pass me, Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……I know. I know your passion
for the 『Oaks』, Cesario……! Even so!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ……Very well. Continuing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaa……haaaa……
One……more……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *cough*, *cough*! ……~~One……more……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaa……wheeze……one……more……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! ……Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ……Status check. Regained composure?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah……thanks, Cesario……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Good. Relief.
……Truly an unreasonable Umamusume, you are.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However――『Believe, and persevere』. That strength,
that brilliance you possess, is truly singular.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……Precisely why.
Does a path uniquely yours not exist?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh――?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Entering 『NHK Mile Cup』――Trainer recommendation.
……Heard from King-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sole G1 intersection between Tiara and
Triple Crown during Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Arena where future talents clash to forge new era――
deciding 『Generation's Fastest』……that is 『NHK Mile Cup』.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! ……Generation's……fastest――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……Truthfully, regret exists. Wanted to clash
as rivals on Triple Tiara stage……
at 『Oaks』 and 『Shuuka Sho』.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yet, trailing behind you at 『Oka Sho』,
conviction arose: your 『Speed』 can reach further heights.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Believing in self, seizing challenge――
unrivaled brilliance awaits.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Kraft. ……Ponder, aspire, believe, advance.
Wield that power. Outshine all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Vessels carrying you beyond your dreams
are those very legs.

Think on it, Kraft. Your hopes,
your dreams, all sights witnessed thus far.

Think on it, Kraft. Your hopes,
your dreams, all sights witnessed thus far.

And then……
the path only you can forge.

And then……
the path only you can forge.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Always revered Triple Tiara. Miracles
woven by Umamusume before were my guiding dream.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Revered Air Groove-san's unbending might.
Revered Sweep-san's untamed brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Countless others too. Chasing predecessors,
linking dreams, hopes, emotions together. ………Though――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Admiration wasn't just because they were
『Triple Tiara racers』. Revered them for who they were――
that's why I dreamed!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Then I must do same.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
By own strength. Shine bright.
Running on these legs, along own path――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Must blaze an unprecedented trail!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Thank you, Cesario.
You're right, aren't you? ……Decision made.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll take 『My Own Path』.
Carve my name upon it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Make everyone chase after my
brilliance, my strides, my strength!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Think I can do it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Trainer showed that path
because belief in you never wavered.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ……Yeah, exactly!
Trainer-san believes in me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove it. At 『NHK Mile Cup』――
I will become 『Generation's Fastest』!
